ms.report:
Plutus Cheatsheet Generator is a web-based platform that enables Cardano developers to browse, search, and export executable Plutus smart contract snippets. The core platform includes a React web application with basic search functionality, PDF/Markdown export, and 20 Plutus snippets validated on Cardano test networks.
Evidence
Live Site: https://plutus-cheatsheet.vercel.app/
GitHub Repository: https://github.com/kwired/Plutus-Cheatsheet-Generator
Documentation: https://github.com/kwired/Plutus-Cheatsheet-Generator/tree/release/v1.0.0/docs
Logs, Screenshots, and PDF Export Evidence: https://github.com/kwired/Plutus-Cheatsheet-Generator/tree/release/v1.0.0/evidence/milestone1
Video Demonstration: https://youtu.be/zhrQRF5fVn0
